flag: Customer says the fees (2 lakhs) are too high or out of budget, and associate fails to justify the value.
template: I completely understand that the fee is a significant investment. However, unlike traditional colleges, our program includes a 100% guaranteed placement with top tech companies. You are essentially securing your child's career, not just a degree. Can we look at the ROI together?

flag: Customer says they want to discuss with their spouse/parents before deciding, and the associate just says 'Okay, I will call back later'.
template: That makes perfect sense; this is an important family decision. To make that conversation easier for you, how about I jump on a quick 5-minute video call with both of you tomorrow evening to answer any questions they might have?

flag: Customer asks about the difficulty of the K-NET exam, and associate makes it sound intimidating or doesn't offer help.
template: The K-NET is challenging, but it's purely aptitude-based, not based on rote memorization. We actually provide a complete free mock-test kit and study guide the moment you register. If your child is good at logic, they will do great.
